1_recheck_cost_halved.note: scored without a baseline: this is the reference value
1_recheck_cost_halved.rule: mean re-check tokens per named-arm session <= 0.5 x the 0.2.0 baseline on the same questions

2_rechecks_that_changed_the_answer.rule: descriptive: each is listed as a KnowCode failure

3_f1_and_recall_at_least_equal.rule: mean paired F1 difference (named - plain, exhaustive labels with items) >= 0 and mean paired recall difference (lower-bound labels) >= 0

4_research_tokens_at_most_equal.rule: median paired difference in session tokens (named - plain) <= 0

5_unprompted_use.rule: KnowCode called in at least 20 of every 24 unprompted sessions (share >= 20/24)
